question: What is the total population of Hindus according to the 2011 Census of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**96.63 crores**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Census 2011__

 
 
• It was the 15th Census of India and the 7th Census of Independent India.
 
• Census 2011 Commissioner: C. Chandramouli
 
• Slogan: Our Census, Our Future
 
• No. of districts: 640
 
• No. of towns: 7933
 
• No.of villages: 640930
 
• The total population of India as per the Census 2011 is 1210.19 million of which 623.7 million were males and 623.7 million were females.
 
• Sex Ratio: 943 Females/1000 Males

• Child Sex Ratio: 919( Rural- 923, Urban- 905)
 
• The density of Population: 382 Person/Km2
 
• Literacy Rate: 74.04% of the total population( males: 82.14% and females: 65.46%)
 
• Population Growth Rate during the decade: 17.7%
